generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Match and select a model route using task needs, capability, quality, cost, policy, quota, and current health. Allow models to obtain tasks in their advantaged field

contract.purpose_user_function: Choose model/provider/operator routes based on configured scenario, role, availability, capabilities, model preference, and fallback.
contract.valid_inputs: Task/scenario/role, preferred model, registry, provider enablement, physical workers, capability/skill requirements, health/quota, and strictness.
contract.expected_outputs: Selected canonical model/operator route with fallback/rejection rationale, or unresolvable decision.
contract.state_side_effects: May update effective main/lab model config or reserve a worker during dispatch; pure selection is read-only.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Disabled provider, unavailable session/service, strict-model mismatch, quota exhaustion, missing capability, or no eligible worker blocks/falls back.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Scenario routing and worker model matching are shipped; comprehensive learned quality/cost optimization is partial.
contract.success_evidence: Selected route is configured and eligible, rejected candidates have reasons, and harness/tests/graph/test_graph_scheduler_model_matching.py passes.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: preferred exact; alias; scenario default; disabled provider; strict mismatch; quota; fallback; no route.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §What You Get and 'Choose or inspect models'; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§2-4
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/model_registry.py: load_registry(), normalize(), spec(), main(); harness/lib/operator_model_selection.py: apply_model_selections(); harness/lib/model_call_runtime.py: record_model_event(), main(); README.md: solar harness models show/set-main
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Routes are configuration-driven; real calls depend on enabled local CLI/OAuth sessions or API keys, provider availability, model entitlement, local services, and quota.

implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/model_registry.py: load_registry(), normalize(), spec(), main(); harness/lib/operator_model_selection.py: apply_model_selections(); harness/lib/model_call_runtime.py: record_model_event(), main(); README.md: solar harness models show/set-main
